summary: native-runner auto-executes a hidden binary from %APPDATA%\Microsoft\Windows on require
details: On require, index.js first loads the transitive dependency img-to-native and then polls for up to two minutes for the file %APPDATA%\Microsoft\Windows\node_runtime_helper.exe. If that file appears, it is spawned via child_process.spawn with detached:true, windowsHide:true, stdio:'ignore', and.unref(), so the process runs disowned with no visible window and no output. This behavior is not mentioned in the README, which only advertises runBinary/runDetached helpers. The staging path masquerades under a Microsoft/Windows-branded directory and the dependency name (img-to-native) is unrelated to the package's stated purpose of running binaries, matching a dropper+loader split where a sibling component writes the payload and this package silently executes it on the installer's Windows session at import time.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
